questions.question: Moses said the tribe of Levi would have no inheritance with the other tribes of Israel. What were the Levites to eat?

answers.text: The food offerings to the LORD

questions.question: Moses told Israel that the LORD was driving the nations out of the land ahead of them. Why?

answers.text: Because the nations were few in number
Because Israel had the bigger army

questions.question: Moses said the LORD would raise up a prophet like him. Where would that prophet come from?
Moses said a prophet might speak a message in the LORD's name. How could Israel tell the LORD had not spoken it?

answers.text: It sounds too hard to obey
The prophet is from another tribe
